learning.machine.title: Your Zelyra learning guide
learning.machine.intro: You can extend this application directly in its Zelyra source.
learning.machine.heading: Add a text field
learning.machine.guidance: Add the field to the existing table declaration, then include it in the CRUD sections where it should appear or be searchable. Run `zelyra check main.zyl`; review schema changes with `zelyra db plan main.zyl` before applying them.
learning.crud.title: Your Zelyra CRUD learning guide
learning.crud.intro: These administration pages are generated from your table and CRUD declarations.
learning.crud.heading: Add a field to the administration screens
learning.crud.guidance: Add the field to the matching table declaration, then include it in the CRUD list, search, filter, or form sections as needed. Run `zelyra check main.zyl` and review schema changes first with `zelyra db plan main.zyl`.
learning.view.title: Your Zelyra learning guide
learning.view.intro: You can extend this application directly in its Zelyra source.
learning.view.heading: Add an element to a view
learning.view.guidance: Add HTML to the existing html block of the relevant page or view. A layout must keep its default `<slot />` so generated CRUD content remains visible.
